Short Definition: Same valid tool call repeating; break the loop by injecting guidance
Fires When (Calculation): count(e in recent(run,W): e.sig == sig) >= K

Short Definition: Invalid or malformed tool call; return a synthetic error so the agent self-corrects
Fires When (Calculation): tool not in registry OR args fail tool schema

Short Definition: Context window swelling over a long run; compress or summarize history
Fires When (Calculation): input_tokens(call) >= ctx_max OR rising over recent(run,W)

Short Definition: Cost rising too fast per step; slow or cheapen before it spikes
Fires When (Calculation): (cost(run) - cost M events ago) / M > slope

Short Definition: Agent using a pricier model than its tier allows; route to the permitted one
Request near-duplicate of a cached one; serve the cached answer
Spend crossing budget thresholds; warn, then steer before the cap
Cache hit rate collapsing (silent cost leak); alert a human
Run not improving over time; pause for review (stuck, not looping)
Fires When (Calculation): completeness gain over last N events <= epsilon

Short Definition: Spend crosses a money line; pause for explicit human approval
Output or args drift unsafe or off-topic; roll back or pause (optional, off hot path)
Spend reaches the budget; stop the run
Step count reaches the max; stop a runaway loop
Worst-case next call would breach budget; stop before any spend
